_about: The game's prefabs: ready-made assemblies of Jak 3's decor, made by the editor from the user's own extracted levels (no data of the game here: names of levels and decor parts only). Each takes, in its level, the index-th instance of the anchor (a decor prototype, or a piece of the level's shell) and every decor element whose middle is within `margin` meters of it (and `grow`: [below, above] more on each axis), not much larger than that box, but the names `exclude` lists; or every element in `box`; or the assembly of the element `assembly` (the structure it is part of, as Select its assembly selects it, cut at `max_size` meters), its box when the level has no element of that name. The recipes marked auto are made by tools/gen_prefab_recipes.py. See src/io/prefab_recipes.h.
